plans.title: Plans
plans.heroOverline: One pass for the whole city
plans.heroSubtitle: Gyms, pools, yoga, martial arts and spas all over Tashkent. Pick where to go today.
plans.downgradeFree: No extra charge: the new limit applies right away
plans.legal: Your subscription renews automatically every 30 days at the plan price. You can turn off auto-renewal at any time in Subscription.

visits.question: How are visits counted?
visits.answer: One visit is one class booking or one drop-in at a venue. Cancelling in time gives the visit back; a late cancellation uses it. Your limit resets at the start of every 30-day period.

freeze.question: Can I freeze my subscription?
freeze.answer: Yes, once a quarter you can freeze it for up to 30 days, for a holiday or while you are ill. The frozen days are added to your period.

cancel.question: How do I cancel?
cancel.answer: Cancel any time in Subscription. You keep access until the end of the paid period and won't be charged again.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.secure: You enter your card on the payment provider's secure page. The app never sees or stores card data.
checkout.sandbox: Demo mode: no money is charged
checkout.processingHint: Keep this screen open, it takes a couple of seconds
